name: Instruct-NeRF2NeRF
definition: A diffusion-based method for editing a NeRF scene guided by text instructions, utilizing InstructPix2Pix [9].
summary: Instruct-NeRF2NeRF edits NeRF scenes via text using InstructPix2Pix, differing from prior methods by integrating diffusion directly into the training loop rather than using modular fields or geometric projection.
